description: Fresh random sample from entire course - independent verification round - SCORED

worst_3_phrases.english: I don't mind if you go
worst_3_phrases.issue: PERSON MISMATCH ERROR: English says 'you go' but Italian says 'vado' (I go). Should be 'non mi dispiace se vai'.

worst_3_phrases.english: you can take time to learn Italian
worst_3_phrases.italian: puoi prendersi tempo per imparare italiano
worst_3_phrases.issue: REFLEXIVE MISMATCH ERROR: 'puoi' (2nd person) with 'prendersi' (3rd person reflexive). Should be 'puoi prenderti tempo per imparare italiano'.

worst_3_phrases.english: I said that there are too many ideas and she was a surprise
worst_3_phrases.italian: ho detto che ci sono troppe idee e era una sorpresa
worst_3_phrases.issue: SEMANTIC ERROR: 'she was a surprise' is nonsensical in both English and Italian. The Italian 'era una sorpresa' means 'it was a surprise'. The sentence lacks coherent meaning.

systematic_issues.description: Italian requires subjunctive after 'penso che' (I think that). Using indicative 'è' instead of subjunctive 'sia', or 'funzionerà' instead of 'funzioni'.
Italian requires subjunctive after expressions of emotion like 'sono felice che'. Using 'ho' instead of 'abbia'.
When subject is 'tu' (puoi), reflexive must match: 'prenderti' not 'prendersi'.
Translation preserves wrong grammatical person between English and Italian.

phrases.english: I am not sure if I can remember the whole sentence

phrases.english: yes I think that this is the only way

phrases.qa_notes: SUBJUNCTIVE ERROR: After 'penso che', Italian requires subjunctive 'sia' not indicative 'è'. Should be 'sì penso che questo sia l'unico modo'.
